svg.title: One pulse picks the axis
svg.desc: Three schedules of the tomography kernel, one per axis, on D5's drive and readout lines. Each starts with the Y90 pulse and the T frame shift. For X, a minus Y90 pulse turns plus X onto Z; for Y, an X90 pulse turns plus Y onto Z; for Z there is no pulse. A readout then measures Z.
